name: Andromeda II
tagline: An Andromeda dwarf spheroidal of special note — its stars show signs of a possible older merger of two still smaller dwarfs.

facts.label: Puzzle
facts.value: Double core hints at a prior merger

history: Andromeda II drew attention when deep imaging suggested it may have two overlapping stellar cores — evidence that it could itself be the merged remnant of two smaller dwarfs, a demonstration that the accretion hierarchy continues down to the faintest scales. Its stars are old and metal-poor and it shares the halo orbit phase space of the other Andromeda satellites, making it a testbed for the dwarf-galaxy assembly problem.
